description.text:
The XY Trainer Kit: Bisharp & Wigglytuff, released in November 2014, held two 30-card half decks with a deck box, a rule book, counters, a Pikachu coin, a playmat and a Trainer Kit Guide for each half deck, and like the first XY kit no booster pack. It was the first kit with no cards of its own: every card is an exact reprint from the XY Series, given the kit's set symbol and a number in the order the example battle draws them, with no rarity mark. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the kit's code unlocked the two halves combined as the Claw Barrage theme deck.

The Bisharp half deck runs on Metal Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.
